05-where-to-put-the-ai-money.html 7/10. A newcomer would follow the three kinds of bet and the rule that a missed number ends the bet, but would get lost in the Proven, Stretch and Wild money pots, which are never clearly defined or told apart.
05-where-to-put-the-ai-money.html 7/10.
